```{r}
#| label: fig-sim-recovery
#| fig-cap: >
#|   Estimated incidence rates (points, with 95% confidence intervals) for
#|   each simulated cluster, against the true rate used to generate it. The
#|   red line is the identity.
ests_summary |>
  autoplot(
    type = "scatter",
    xvar = "lambda.sim",
    CI = TRUE,
    dodge_width = .05
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_function(
    fun = function(x) x,
    col = "red",
    aes(linetype = "data-generating incidence rate")
  ) +
  labs(linetype = "") +
  scale_x_log10()
```

::: notes
Each point is one simulated cluster. The estimates scatter around the
identity line, and the confidence intervals widen at higher incidence.
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

`analyze_sims()` summarizes the simulation results across clusters:

```{r}
#| label: analyze-sims
ests_summary |> analyze_sims()
```

{{< slidebreak >}}

```{r}
#| label: fig-empirical-se
#| fig-cap: >
#|   Empirical standard error of the incidence estimates, by true rate.
ests_summary |>
  analyze_sims() |>
  autoplot(statistic = "Empirical_SE")
```
